summary.name: CodeEdit
summary.one_liner: CodeEdit is an open-source code editor built natively for macOS in Swift, positioned as a lightweight companion to Xcode for non-Apple projects.
use_cases: editing code in projects not targeting Apple platforms
lightweight day-to-day code editing on a Mac
contributing features or fixes to an open source editor
customizing an editor to personal workflow
summary.what_it_does: CodeEdit is a code editor written entirely for macOS using Swift, with the stated goal of feeling at home on a Mac. The page says it is meant to supplement Xcode rather than replace it, aimed at projects not intended for Apple platforms. It is described as lightweight, and the page says it is extensible and customizable. The project is open source, with users invited to file issues or submit pull requests. The page does not list specific language support or detailed feature lists.
notable: Native macOS architecture built in Swift
Open source, with contributions via issues and PRs
Positioned as a supplement to Xcode for non-Apple projects
caveats: Page does not list specific language support or detailed features
